newsitem.title: HONG KONG: RESEARCH ALERT - HK & China Gas cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - HK & China Gas cut.

text.p: Asia Equity said it had cut its rating on Hong Kong and China Gas Co Ltd to sell from buy due to a slowdown in net profit growth, the disappointing performance of China projects and a diversification into property.
"Net profit growth is slowing from 20 percent to the mid/high teens," Asia Equity said in a recent research report.
"In 1996, total sales growth slowed to 4.6 percent versus the company's earlier forecast of six to seven percent."
Asia Equity said Hong Kong and China Gas' existing China projects were operating below expectations and new ones were taking longer to materialise.
"The three projects -- Panyu, Zhongsan and Fangcun -- won't be profitable until 2000 (vs previously forecast 1999) as sales are slower and the operating environment tougher than expected," it said.
"There has been little progress on the Guangzhou and Shantou projects, which have been in negotiations since 1995."
Asia Equity said HK$3.5 billion in cash raised from a warrant conversion this year and intended for China expansion was likely to be diverted for other uses such as property development.
"If that is the case, the stock's rating should partly reflect the risks of this cyclical business," it said.
Asia Equity forecasts 1997 net profit of HK$2.27 billion compared with HK$1.95 billion in 1996.
Hong Kong and China Gas shares were down HK$0.05 at HK$12.55 in Wednesday morning trade.
